approach.required_fields: Added missing id, title, and purpose fields to SOPs that lacked them (efficiency_guide, tool_sops, future_team_data_strategy)
approach.operational_content: Added a standardized 'procedures' array to all 10 SOPs. Each procedures array contains 4-6 actionable steps derived from the SOP's existing rich content (sections, phases, checklists).
